'''LR-5 sentinel droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was destroyed in [[3639 BBY]], by a strike team that [[Mission to the Lost Island|stormed]] Lorrick's [[Lost Island|lab]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==Behind the scenes==
LR-5 sentinel droid appears in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]]'' [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the flashpoint "Lost Island".<ref name="SWTOR" />
